sources.finding: State Council approval dated 2021-09-30 establishes Sanjiangyuan National Park, addressed to Qinghai and Tibet governments.
Nature reserve established 2000-08-19, national reserve approved 2003-01-24, national park formally established October 2021.

assessment: Textbook confuses the 2000 reserve with the 2021 national park; factual erratum, not OCR.
